truth.toolchain: node 22.22.0; jest 30.5.2, ts-jest 29.4.14, typescript 5.9; mutant hand-applied to the anchor line (StrykerJS 10's compound-assignment mutant), run with the test command on the whole package

reasoning: The module declares `const test = (_name, _body) => {}`, so the registration never runs and its `toBe(9)` is never evaluated; only the `it` placeholder runs.
